issues.description: Method 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()' visibility differs between the problem specification and the solution implementation. In the UML in problem_statement.md (line 70) the method is specified as public ('+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int'), while in the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, line 75) the method is declared as protected ('protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()'). This inconsistency between the specified API and the provided implementation can confuse students about the intended accessibility and may lead to mismatches with tests or expected usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferred fix: change the implementation to public by updating the solution and template Lecture.java signature to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' so it matches the UML and problem text. Alternatively, if protected visibility was intentional, update the UML and problem statement to show the method as protected and document the rationale.
